items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: But I played with Freddie, you know. That's something I forgot to tell you. Now that was a trumpet player in the band.

ctx.x: Was there any of the guys playing like Freddie Caput down here?

Well, no. But I played with Freddie, you know. That's something I forgot to tell you. Now that was a trumpet player in the band. See, I went to that dream and there were so many different fellows, but now I went there with Freddie Caput. But how it happened, it wasn't tying the band to Freddie Caput band. Oh yeah. But I went there with him.
Who was in the band with Freddie?
